comments.author: @UnseenOutlands
comments.text: The situation in West Point really made me think about what home means when the environment becomes dangerous. If high water can reach houses at night, what keeps families connected to that neighborhood? Is it proximity to work, family networks, the cost of moving, or something deeper? What kind of support would make life safer without breaking those community ties?

replies.author: @PlanetVista4K
replies.text: That's a deeply thoughtful perspective on the resilience of these families and the complex challenges they face in maintaining their community ties! 🌍
